description: In the Pivot Table Layout dialog the auto-generated Data field cannot be dragged from Column Fields to Row Fields.
expected_report: With Sales and Cost as data fields, the user opens Pivot Table Layout and drags the 'Data' field from Column Fields to Row Fields: nothing happens, no message. Expected: the field moves so data values are shown vertically. Workaround: Ctrl-drag on the sheet.
difficulty: Drag in a dense dialog with small labels; the bug is the absence of a change.
